An internal penetration test on an AD domain with unpatched legacy systems (e.g., CVE-2021-4034 [PwnKit] or CVE-2022-26809 [RPC vulnerability]) requires a structured approach leveraging tools like **BloodHound**, **PowerSploit**, **Mimikatz**, and **CrackMapExec (CME)**. If constrained delegation is configured, abuse protocols like **Protocol Transition** or **Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD)** with **Rubeus** or **PowerMad** to impersonate high-privilege accounts. Mitigate by enforcing LAPS (Local Admin Password Solution), patching systems, disabling unused SPNs, and implementing tiered admin model (Microsoft’s ESAE).
